advisories.title: The extraction pins no HEAD, no file 08 digest and no required-now figure, and carries no reviewStatus or sealRecommendation
advisories.detail: The subject's thirteen top-level keys include parent, parentSha256 and parentReview but none of head, file08Pin, requiredNowUnchanged, reviewStatus or sealRecommendation. I checked whether this is a v3 regression and it is not: v1 and v2 lack all five as well, so it is the established shape for this thin-extraction family, and the parent does carry file08Pin, which is where the design puts the register pin. The residue is that this file alone does not record which commit it was extracted against, so a reader holding only this artifact cannot date the extraction or tell whether the parent has moved since. Every other candidate I have reviewed this session pins HEAD. Adding head and a one-line requiredNowUnchanged would cost nothing and would make the extraction self-dating; carrying reviewStatus and sealRecommendation would match the corpus convention for an artifact that is itself dispatched for independent review.

advisories.detail: This subject's authority rests on the parent being independently reviewed, and it reports that accurately: parentReview pins 3f2146ec, which reproduces and records ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nothing here is misstated by the subject — it is reporting the verdict, not the parent's self-description — and this is the parent's business rather than the extraction's, which is why it is an advisory against this file rather than a finding. The no-load observation is separated from the timing samples in three places — exactByteIntent splits 21 timing records from one dedicated observation record per command, failsIf forbids taking the observation on a timing sample, and standingVsD102 says never a G03/G04 timing sample.
